question: Which form of Caṇḍa should be placed in the northeast direction?
premises: Skanda-Caṇḍa should be placed in the northeast.
He is excellent and holds the Vedas in his hands.
inference: In the northeast one should place the excellent Skanda-Caṇḍa who holds the Vedas.
plain_english: In the northeast one should place the excellent Skanda-Caṇḍa, who holds the Vedas in his hands.
